name: code/scraper
title: Page scraper
summary: Python page scraper on the standard library: fetch with a timeout, pull links and tables out of the HTML, save as CSV.
when: Use when a page's links or tables have to be pulled out of the HTML and saved as CSV without installing a parser.

name.about: Script name, used for the file name, the prog name in the help text and the user agent (lowercase, underscores).

next: Write the files, run python3 -m pytest -q to confirm the scraper tests pass, then run python3 {{name}}.py https://example.com --what links --out links.csv.
